disposition.note: Section 16 now has ten test cases. TC-E1-070-08-ITG covers the section 12 contract, and TC-E1-070-09-ITG and TC-E1-070-10-ITG cover AC8 and AC9.

edits.old: The eight test cases of section 16 pass in SIT
edits.new: The ten test cases of section 16 pass in SIT

edits.old:
Given the smoke run has started the activity RecordAndApply on task queue rwb-case under the workflow ID platform-smoke-20261116
    When the first attempt of the activity times out
    Then the activity is retried on the same task queue rwb-case under the same workflow ID and no second run is started
    When the retried attempt completes
    Then the write is recorded once and the history holds one completed activity for the step
    When the activity EvaluateRules on task queue rwb-decision times out
    Then the run does not write and the workflow ID stays the key of the run
edits.new:
Given the smoke run has started the activity EvaluateRules on task queue rwb-decision under the workflow ID platform-smoke-20261116
    When an attempt of the activity EvaluateRules times out
    Then the run does not write while EvaluateRules has not completed and the workflow ID stays the key of the run
    When EvaluateRules has completed and the first attempt of the activity RecordAndApply on task queue rwb-case times out
    Then the activity is retried on the same task queue rwb-case under the same workflow ID and no second run is started
    When the retried attempt completes
    Then the write is recorded once and the history holds one completed activity for the step

findings.issue: Section 16 has ten test cases (01-07 plus new 08, 09, 10), but 'Done when' and the disposition note say eight.
